title: Chapter 174 Daring To Pursue Love
content:
Chapter 174 Daring To Pursue Love

That day, in the City Lord's Mansion.

"The weather is really nice today."

Lu Daosheng yawned, stretched his body, and then walked out lazily.

His steps were obviously a little shaky, obviously he had exercised too much.

"An Xing."

Lu Daosheng lay on the rocking chair in the yard and called.

The next moment, An Xing walked slowly from outside.

"Lord City Lord."

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Nothing has happened in the city recently, right?"

"Lord City Lord, after the war, everyone is in seclusion, and nothing has happened in the city."

"It's just that,"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows and looked at An Xing.

"What's wrong?"

An Xing paused, and then told Lu Daosheng about Gu Chen and Mu Yu.

Halfway through the story, Yan Lingyun also walked out of the house slowly, sat next to Lu Daosheng and listened to An Xing.

"Lord City Lord, that's it."

At this time, Lu Daosheng's expression was very wonderful.

"Haha, I really didn't expect it."

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked at each other and then laughed.

"Jian Xin and the others have gone back?"

Yan Lingyun asked.

An Xing nodded, "Yes, Madam, they have all returned to the Divine Dynasty."

Yan Lingyun turned to look at Lu Daosheng, "It seems that I have to go back too."

Lu Daosheng was not surprised to hear Yan Lingyun's words.

Yan Lingyun also spent a lot of effort in the establishment of the Divine Dynasty, so it is impossible for her to ignore it.

"Come here."

As the voice fell, a shadow appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord, please give me your orders."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand and said, "Go and call Gu Chen."

The shadow nodded respectfully, "Yes, Lord City Lord."

Then, the shadow disappeared from the spot.

An Xing was shocked at the side. The Lord City Lord really cultivated many strong people in secret.

The shadow just now made him feel a little palpitated.

Not long after, a somewhat decadent figure slowly walked towards here.

It was none other than Gu Chen.

"Subordinate, meet the Lord of the City."

Gu Chen bowed respectfully to Lu Daosheng.

Seeing Gu Chen like this, several people were a little surprised.

"Gu Chen, how did you get into this state?"

Lu Daosheng looked Gu Chen up and down and asked.

Hearing this, Gu Chen immediately showed a bitter smile.

Ever since Mu Yu left crying, Gu Chen returned to his residence and began to retreat.

However, for some reason, as soon as he closed his eyes, the shy expression of Mu Yu holding the staff in his hand appeared in his mind.

As a result, he couldn't concentrate on his cultivation at all, and he almost went astray.

Thinking of this, Gu Chen sighed heavily.

Seeing Gu Chen's worried look, Lu Daosheng and others laughed in their hearts.

At this time, Lu Xue also came trotting over from a distance.

"Dad, Mom."

"Hey, Master, An Xing, everyone is here."

Seeing Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled and waved to Lu Xue.

And Lu Xue also walked towards Lu Daosheng very obediently.

"Dad."

"Xiaoxue, do you miss Dad?"

Lu Daosheng smiled.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun on the side immediately rolled her eyes at Lu Daosheng, her face was very speechless.

And Lu Xue's face was also slightly red.

"Dad, I'm so old, don't say such mushy words."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately laughed.

At this time, Lu Xue noticed that Gu Chen's face was a little wrong.

"Huh? Master, why are you like this?"

Gu Chen pursed his lips and wanted to say something, but he didn't say anything, just shook his head and sighed.

Seeing this, Lu Xue immediately understood.

"Ah~"

"Master, you don't regret it, do you?"

"Master, it's still not too late to regret now. You can go to the Divine Dynasty to find Miss Mu Yu."

After hearing Lu Xue's words, everyone looked at Gu Chen.

And Gu Chen was also slightly stunned, lowering his head to think.

Go to the Divine Dynasty to find Mu Yu?

I always feel that it's not good, after all, that kind of thing happened between the two of them last time.

I guess the other party doesn't want to see me at all.

As if seeing Gu Chen's thoughts, Yan Lingyun stood up and said: "Gu Chen, I'm going back to the Divine Dynasty soon, you can go back with me."

Hearing this, Gu Chen hesitated, and then looked at Lu Daosheng.

After Lu Daosheng nodded in agreement, Gu Chen no longer hesitated.

"Okay, then trouble Madam."

Yan Lingyun smiled and said slowly: "I also hope you can succeed. Mu Yu, that girl, has never had such an idea before."

Hearing this, Gu Chen looked embarrassed.

Then, after a brief farewell, Yan Lingyun took Gu Chen and left the deserted city directly, heading towards the direction of the Divine Dynasty.

After all, Yan Lingyun was just going back to explain some things and would be back soon.

"Yeah! Master went to pursue love boldly!!"

Next to Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue seemed a little excited, and wanted to follow him to supervise the battle in person.

"Dad, do you think my master can succeed?"

Lu Xue turned her head and asked Lu Daosheng.

"Uh, well, "

Lu Daosheng chuckled, "it depends on whether your master has real skills."

Some women, once they turn around, it is difficult to turn back.

Gu Chen has already wasted an opportunity, so it is still very difficult.

"Lord City Lord, I will take my leave first."

At this time, An Xing said.

Lu Daosheng nodded.

Then, An Xing left here.

Returning to his residence, An Xing hurriedly gave orders.

In less than a moment, two figures appeared in front of An Xing.

"My Lord, what do you want?"

The two are members of the Root Organization, and their status is extremely high. They only accept An Xing's orders.

An Xing said lightly: "Go to the Divine Dynasty immediately and pay attention to Gu Chen's movements. Don't be too close, just report back what happened."

Hearing this, the two did not ask more questions, and nodded directly: "Yes, my Lord."

After the two left.

An Xing stood outside, looking into the distance, muttering to himself, "Gu Chen, you must wake up this time, otherwise, you will be single for the rest of your life. I am worried about you, brother."

At the same time, in A Wei's house.

A Wei was sitting at the table, and on his lap, there was a petite and lovely woman.

"Husband, do you really not care about Gu Chen's affairs?"

Fan Yingying hesitated and said.

The soft voice made A Wei confused.

"Haha, it's okay, I believe him."

A Wei chuckled.

Then, A Wei stared at Fan Yingying's cute big eyes.

Being stared at by A Wei, Fan Yingying's face suddenly turned red and she was at a loss.

"Husband, you, why are you staring at me like this?"

"Yingying, do you want a child?"

A Wei said seriously.

Hearing this, Fan Yingying's face suddenly turned red, and she quickly covered her face with her hands.

"Husband, if you want, I will give birth to you."

The voice was very soft, but Ah Wei still heard it.

Then, a loud laugh rang out from the house.
